value.rationale: One fully classified natural finite-observation fragment of the 2026 knowing-value successor logic. The interaction of S5 knowledge with conditional knowing value detects precisely whether unnamed distinct values occur zero, one, or at least twice. The result identifies a complete expressive invariant for arbitrary nesting, provides explicit depth-one characteristic translations, sharp per-signature and uniform models independent of formula depth, and computes all pointed theories and definable properties. This is a complete structural classification with a natural parameter, not merely a numerical toy slice or restatement of known FMP.
